name: (04) Vicissitude — 3 Advanced — Breath of the Dragon

system.description:
You vomit forth your vitae even as you convert it to a combustible fluid that bursts into hellish flame on leaving your mouth — a focused jet against one foe, or a wide spray over a crowd.

You are immune to this flame, though not to secondary fires it sets. To strike a single target within 100 feet, spend one Blood Trait and win a Physical Challenge: he takes three levels of aggravated damage and bursts alight, suffering two more levels the next turn and one each turn after until the fire is put out or he dies. To incinerate an area, spend five Blood Traits and center a 20-foot-radius blast on any point within 100 feet of your line of sight; everyone inside takes two levels of aggravated damage and all flammable objects ignite. Victims must win a Static Physical Challenge at a five-Trait difficulty or catch fire themselves, taking one additional aggravated level per turn while burning or while they remain in the blaze.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait (single target) or 5 Blood Traits (area)
